product_intent: A small desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually opened by a user's thumb release

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid.
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb.
The box should be safe to use, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually opened by a user's thumb release

verification.observable: The lid remains closed under normal conditions until thumb pressure is applied to release it
verification.condition: Under normal operating conditions with user thumb pressure applied

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: Absence of sharp edges, toxic materials, or hazardous components
verification.condition: At time of product delivery and use

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly requires minimal tools and steps

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Manufacturing process can be completed with standard production methods

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized
The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Operation requires no external power source or mechanical assistance

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Design features compatible with additive manufacturing process

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Use
operating_scenarios.description: User handles the storage box and applies thumb pressure to open the lid

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing Process
operating_scenarios.description: Storage box is produced using additive manufacturing techniques

declared_absent.freedoms: No explicit freedoms were declared in the request or clarifications
declared_absent.relations: No conflicting, dependent, refining, or duplicating requirements identified
declared_absent.unknowns: No unspecified information required for requirement determination
